Subject: Q4 product/eng snapshot — launch timelines, risk triage, exec asks

Team — attaching a tight snapshot ahead of tomorrow's QBR dry run. High-level asks up front: can we land decisions on scope trims for the two highest-risk launches and confirm a go/no-go gating plan for Acme (priority customer)?

Summary (TL;DR):
- Launch slate: Editor-API v2 (internal), Hosted Multi-model rollout (customer-facing), Acme custom routing (customer-facing).
- Current critical risks: Acme routing performance under 99th pct latency, dependency on a new kernel build for quantized models, and SSO/cert expiry that impacts Dedicated onboarding.
- Exec asks: 1) Approve reduced-time path for Acme (drop noncritical analytics in initial ship), 2) Confirm contingency region for Hosted Multi-model, 3) Approve canary cadence for Editor-API v2.

Files: risk_register_Q4_v2.xlsx (risk tags + owners), timeline_comparison_Q4.pdf (current vs baseline), proposed_canary_plan.docx (canary steps and metrics).

Please reply with short bullets (Decide / Defer / Owner) — I will consolidate and present at 10:30.

Thanks,
Neha

Neha — quick read, thanks. My notes:
- Acme routing: I support the analytics haircut (Decide) — latency is the gating metric. Marcus to confirm perf delta with the kernal patch in next 24h.
- Hosted Multi-model: we should lock a secondary region (EU-west) for canary; Operations to confirm capacity. Monica, can you validate?
- Editor-API v2: canary cadence looks fine; ask infra to add an automatic rollback on error rate >0.5% for first 48 hours.

I'll be on the dry run and can speak to the tradeoffs.

— Vivek

VP Engineering
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 product/eng snapshot — launch timelines, risk triage, exec asks

Folks — dug into the kernel/quant issue and attached a focused risk register slice. Short bullets:
- Kernel patch (K-1.14) reduces memory by ~18% on our L2 quant path but introduces a 5–8ms 99th tail on long-context workloads; the trade is acceptable for most customers but not for Acme at current config.
- Mitigation options: A) keep K-1.14 + aggressive prefix caching for Acme (owner: Marcus) — medium effort; B) backport a tuned ad-hoc kernel for Acme only (owner: infra-engineering) — high effort; C) delay Acme until a full kernel validation (owner: PM/Eng decision) — high schedule impact.
- Timeline: option A can be staged in 3 working days for canary; B is ~3 weeks.

Attachment: risk_register_Q4_v2.xlsx (sheet: kernel_quant_slice).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, ML Infra
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 product/eng snapshot — launch timelines, risk triage, exec asks

Short answers for the dry run (Decide / Owner):
- Acme routing perf: Decide -> Proceed with option A (K-1.14 + aggressive prefix caching) as canary path. Owner: Marcus (implement), Monica (customer communication).
- Hosted Multi-model region: Decide -> EU-west as secondary canary region. Owner: Monica + Ops.
- Editor-API v2 canary: Decide -> Approve cadence with rollback rule; Owner: Infra (Vivek to confirm rollback automation).

I'll approve a small uplift in SRE oncall for the first 72 hours for Acme canary (cost covered by Q4 launch budget).

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Product Strategy
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q4 product/eng snapshot — launch timelines, risk triage, exec asks

Thanks — consolidating decisions for the exec dry run (10:30 PST tomorrow). Final summary to present: 
1) Acme: proceed with Option A (Marcus/Infra + Monica for comms). Canaries start Wed; rollback thresholds and postmort plan attached.
2) Hosted Multi-model: EU-west selected as secondary canary; Ops to confirm capacity by EOD tomorrow.
3) Editor-API v2: canary cadence approved; infra to enable auto-rollback at >0.5% error.

Open items (I'll raise during dry run):
- Confirmation of short-term analytics removal scope for Acme (explicit list needed — Monica/Account team).
- DocuSign timeline for Acme contract amendment (Procurement) — Monica, can you loop procurement?

Attachments included in the thread. If no objections, I'll mark these as decisions and circulate to Sales/Customer Success post-QBR.

Neha
Head of Product, Platform
Redwood Inference
